div.div:
Key Challenge
Model weights live on networked Lustre.
mmap: each 4 KB page fault = 1 network RPC.
61 GB ÷ 4 KB ≈ 16 M round trips over the fabric.

div.div:
Two storage paths:
① Local NVMe /tmp — fast, capacity-limited, requires pre-copy
② Lustre /work/nvme — shared, high-latency per-RPC, default path
